name: Greenvale Basin
description: The charter heartland: fertile river fields and the first council roads.

name: Blackwood March
description: Deep timber, old barrows, and villages that trust the forest more than charters.

name: Stoneback Hills
description: Quarries, ridge tracks, and hard country between valley and pass.

name: Northwatch Pass
description: Cold approaches where any realm road must become a watch road.

name: Ash Coast
description: Wind-cut shoreland, salt stacks, and boat villages beyond easy council reach.

name: Duskvale Lowlands
description: Marsh road, reed trade, hidden causeways, and slow-moving danger.
